Maria (CS): Heads-up: PolarisHealth renewal flagged — ~48% seat activity drop over last 30d. New Head of Data started last week and they're re-evaluating vendors (mentioned ApexAI). Need quick triage.
Tanay (SE): Do we know which endpoints dropped? embeddings vs generation? any errors?
Maria (CS): Quick export attached in thread (summary below). No error spike. Looks like fewer active seats + lower gen volume.
Maria (CS): ```last_30d summary
- total_requests: 12,430
- active_seats: 18 -> 9 (48% drop)
- gen_tokens/day: 270k -> 140k
- embeddings/day: 3.2k -> 2.9k
```
Tanay (SE): Got it. Gen traffic down much more. Could be product change or pilot ended. I'll check API keys & recent feature flags.
Julia (CSM): I talked to their champion (Nora) yesterday — she said their ML team paused a pilot while new Head of Data re-assesses inference costs. No major outages.
Mike (AE): I'll hop on this. Suggested play: 1) short cost/latency comparison we can share 2) offer 2-week Dedicated trial for their ML team 3) coordinate intro call with Head of Data.
Maria (CS): Agree. Also propose a one-pager showing predictable latency + rollout controls (canary, pin versions). That hits their risk concerns.
Tanay (SE): I'll produce a 1-page perf/cost slide with our perf numbers vs ApexAI for similar model shapes. Need to know their avg seq len — do we have telemetry?
Maria (CS): Nora said typical seq ~512 for gen, occasional 1024. I'll surface exact telemetry via dashboard link.
ops-bot: Reminder: PolarisHealth renewal in 21 days — owner: Mike (AE).
Mike (AE): Scheduling: propose intro call Thurs 10am PT with Nora + Head of Data. Can Julia join for QBR context?
Julia (CSM): Yes can join. I'll prep a short usage narrative and key ask list.
Tanay (SE): I'll attach microbench numbers and a short runbook for a quick on-prem/Private proof if they ask.
Maria (CS): Action items: Mike schedule call, Tanay perf one-pager, Julia usage narrative + ask list, Maria to draft canary + Dedicated trial offer. I'll DM Nora to confirm Thurs.
Mike (AE): Aiming to send materials by EOD Wednesday so their Head of Data has time.
Maria (CS): One more: capture competitor claims (latency/cost) during call — we may need to counter with real traces and rollout story. :eyes:
Tanay (SE): I'll prepare a 1-slide cost sensitivity table (quantization + batching impact).
Julia (CSM): Noted. I'll also capture any product ask for the handoff doc and a short eval prompt set to validate quality regressions.
Maria (CS): Thanks team. If call goes sideways, we'll offer a short no-cost pilot to repro their pipeline. :thumbsup:
Mike (AE): On it.
Maria (CS): last: logging ticket #CS-3421 attached for audit trail and next steps.
